content_sections.heading: How to Apply for JMC Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Visit the OJAS portal (ojas.gujarat.gov.in) to fill out the online application form. Submit separate applications if applying for more than one post and pay individual fees. Do not upload any certificates or documents with the online application. Note down the confirmation number after successful submission and fee payment. Keep copies of the passport-size photo used in the application for future stages. Apply on or before 17 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online only through OJAS portal. No hard copies of applications or documents need to be sent by post initially. Selected candidates for certain health posts may be appointed under 100% grant-aided Urban Health Project.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for JMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 17 November 2026. Applications opened on 28 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in JMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 31 vacancies: 1 Gynecologist Class-1, 2 Pediatrician Class-1, 1 Food Analyst Class-2, 5 Medical Officer Class-2, 10 Staff Nurse Class-3, 8 Senior Clerk (Tax Inspector / Recovery Officer) Class-3 and 1 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for JMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 17 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Unreserved, SEBC, EWS male candidates: Rs. 1000. All female candidates, SC, ST, Ex-Servicemen, PwD candidates: Rs. 500.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - Gynecologist Class-1: 18 to 40 years; Pediatrician Class-1: 18 to 40 years; Food Analyst Class-2: 18 to 40 years; Medical Officer Class-2: 18 to 35 years; Staff Nurse Class-3: 18 to 40 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: L-11 (67,700 - 2,08,700) for Gynecologist Class-1, L-11 (67,700 - 2,08,700) for Pediatrician Class-1, L-9 (53,100 - 1,67,800) for Food Analyst Class-2, L-9 (53,100 - 1,67,800) for Medical Officer Class-2, L-5 (29,200 - 92,300) for Staff Nurse Class-3.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: MBBS, MD, Diploma, Bachelor's/Master's Degree in Science/Chemistry/Microbiology, B.Sc. Nursing, Graduation with Experience, Graduate with CCC. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be a citizen of India or eligible refugee/migrant as per rules. Must possess required computer knowledge certification. Must pass CCC/CCC+ exam during probation period if applicable.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates providing false details in the online application will have their candidature cancelled.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Competitive online written exam (CBRT / OMR). Document verification. Oral interview (where applicable). Single-stage competitive exam using CBRT or OMR method.
